sql.if: AND (UPPER(prpty.prpty_nm) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{searchName}||'%') OR UPPER(prpty.prpty_logic_nm) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{searchName}||'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: ModelPropertyMapper.selectModelPropertyCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_model model INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty modelPrpty on model.model_id = modelPrpty.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty on prpty.prpty_id = modelPrpty .prpty_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine prptyDefine on prpty .prpty_id = prptyDefine.prpty_id AND prptyDefine.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rangeModel on prptyDefine.range_model_id = rangeModel.model_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ModelPropertyMapper.selectModelPropertyList */ (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY modelPrpty.model_prpty_sort_odrg)) AS model_prpty_sort_odrg ,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY modelPrpty.model_prpty_del_yn, modelPrpty.model_prpty_sort_odrg)) AS rownum ,model.model_id ,model.model_nm ,modelPrpty.prpty_id ,prpty.prpty_nm ,prpty.prpty_logic_nm ,prpty.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd ,prptyDefine.range_model_id ,rangeModel.model_nm AS rangeModelNm ,rangeModel.model_data_sttus_mtcd AS rangeModelDataSttusMtcd ,domnModel.model_nm AS domnModelNm ,modelPrpty.model_prpty_mand_mtcd ,code.mtcd_nm AS modelPrptyMandMtcdNm ,CASE WHEN c2.mtcd IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS setUsgPrptyYn ,rangeModel.data_type_mtcd AS range_data_type_mtcd ,rangeModel.model_type_mtcd AS range_model_type_mtcd ,modelprpty.model_prpty_val_exam ,modelprpty.std_model_id ,stdModel.model_nm AS std_model_nm ,prpty.cnt_prpty_yn ,prpty.cnt_model_id ,modelprpty.model_prpty_del_yn ,modelprpty.model_prpty_delr_id ,modelprpty.model_prpty_delr_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty modelPrpty INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model model on modelPrpty.model_id = model.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty on prpty.prpty_id = modelPrpty .prpty_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine prptyDefine on prpty .prpty_id = prptyDefine.prpty_id AND prptyDefine.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rangeModel on prptyDefine.range_model_id = rangeModel.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model domnModel ON prptyDefine.domn_model_id = domnModel.model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code code on modelPrpty .model_prpty_mand_mtcd = code.mtcd and code.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00004' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c2 ON rangeModel.data_type_mtcd = c2.mtcd AND c2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00013' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model stdModel on modelPrpty.std_model_id = stdModel.model_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ModelPropertyMapper.selectStdModelPropertyCountForDelCheck */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id WHERE t2.type_model_id = #{typeModelId} AND t2.up_model_id != 'Class' AND t1.prpty_id = #{prptyId} AND t1.model_prpty_del_yn = 'N'
SELECT /* SQL_ID: ModelPropertyMapper.selectMetaDataUseCheck*/ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data meta WHERE meta.model_prpty_id = #{modelPrptyId}
SELECT /* SQL_ID: ModelPropertyMapper.selectMetaDataCheckByProperty*/ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data meta WHERE meta.prpty_id = #{prptyId}
